name: feedBack-Demucs-Server
description: A standalone GPU-accelerated companion server for feedBack. Offloads PyTorch/Demucs stem-splitting, Whisper lyrics alignment, and pitch extraction tasks to a separate CUDA-capable GPU. IMPORTANT: On first launch, this container will download several large AI model weights (Roformer, Whisper, Crepe), which requires 9GB+ of disk space and can take several minutes depending on your internet speed. Please be patient. GPU PASSTHROUGH: To enable GPU acceleration, you must have the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin installed and add --gpus all to your Extra Parameters.

paths.name: Cache Directory
paths.description: Location for downloaded model weights (Demucs, Whisper, Crepe) and transient audio caches.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: The port for the Demucs Server REST API (defaulted to 8020)

variables.name: Demucs Model
variables.description: The default Demucs separation model (e.g., htdemucs_ft, htdemucs, htdemucs_6s).

variables.name: Device
variables.description: Optional: The device PyTorch should use (e.g., cuda, cpu). Leave blank to auto-detect Nvidia GPU.

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Optional: API authentication key to secure the Demucs server endpoints.

variables.name: Cache TTL
variables.description: Maximum age of transient audio/stems cache folders before deletion (e.g., 1h, 12h, 24h, or NEVER to disable auto-cleanup).

variables.name: Skip Warmup
variables.description: Set to true to skip downloading AI model weights on container startup. (Weights will instead download on-demand on the first request).

variables.name: HuggingFace Cache Location
variables.description: Redirects HuggingFace models to the persistent cache directory.

variables.name: PyTorch Cache Location
variables.description: Redirects PyTorch models to the persistent cache directory.

variables.name: HuggingFace Hub Cache Location
variables.description: Redirects HuggingFace hub downloads to the persistent cache directory.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Enables auto-updates of server files at the configured update time (Requires .git mount).

variables.name: Update Time
variables.description: Daily time check for updates (HH:MM format).

variables.name: Update Check Interval
variables.description: Seconds between daily time check sweeps.

variables.name: PORT Env
variables.description: Internal port the Demucs server listens to inside the container.
